name: ExAP Awareness Agent
description: A remote agent that creates and evaluates ExAP Attention Contracts and returns Attention Events as artifacts.

skills.name: Create Attention Contract
skills.description: Create an ExAP contract from structured parameters or a natural language monitoring intent.
examples: Monitor this training process and interrupt me only for failures or GPU idle.

skills.name: Wait for Attention Event
skills.description: Wait for an ExAP Attention Event or contract terminal state.
